title: 第三千三百七十四章 行动起来第三千三百七十三章 温馨
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
他们并没有在这个山谷待太久。
血色天幕的影响力，正在快速扩散，随着血色天幕的收缩，大家只能往圣地深处逃窜。
这也引发了更多的战斗。
三天后。
一个消息传递了出来。
星无极在圣地北境的断魂崖上，当众截杀了独行强者萧云。
萧云头顶的数字是12，在整个圣地里也能排进前十，两人在断魂崖上打了不到一炷香，萧云的脑袋就被星无极一掌拍碎，爆出的天门令，化作洪流涌入星无极体内。
天门令的规则很简单，数字就是纯粹的累加，你有多少枚天门令，头顶就显示多少数字。
所以当星无极从断魂崖上走下来的时候，头顶的数字已经从13跳到了25。
25。
在所有人都还在为冲破十二环拼命的时候，星无极已经站到了一个让绝大多数人望尘莫及的高度。
……
杀一个人，数字直接翻了一倍。
这就是天门令最残酷也最诱人的地方，你不需要苦修，不需要感悟，只需要杀一个和你差不多拥有数字的人，就能在一瞬间跨越别人几个月的积累。
星无极显然深谙此道。
杀掉萧云之后，他没有停手，而是站在断魂崖上对所有围观的人说了一句话。
“天门洗礼圣地，不需要那么多数字级的存在。
从今天起，要么归顺我，要么死。”
……
接下来的三天里，圣地彻底变成了一座修罗场。

第二天，圣地西境。
狼七追上了另一个独行强者，结束战斗后，头顶的数字从15跳到了26。
消息传开不到半天，花千玥就在南境杀敌，数字跳到了24。
第三天，星无极又出手了，数字从25跳到了34。
三天之内，圣地里仅存的几个独行数字级强者被三巨头屠戮殆尽。
整个圣地的天门令以一种前所未有的速度向三个人集中。
等到第四天早上的时候，星无极的数字已经到了34，狼七26，花千玥24。
三人加起来，数字总和超过八十。
而血色天幕，在这三天里又收拢了不少，可活动的范围，也是越来越小。
天幕边缘已经没有人了，之前徘徊在边缘的那些散修，要么被天幕抽成了枯骨，要么拼了命地往圣地深处逃。
那些没有归顺三巨头的散修们开始走投无路。
因为三巨头的手下把守了所有通往核心区域的通道，不归顺就杀。
整个圣地，变成了一座巨大的斗兽场。
而三巨头，就是这座斗兽场里最凶猛的三头野兽。
秦天和殷洛璃这几天没有出手。
原因是附近有眼线盯着他们，各大强者都在刻意避开他们。
杀了眼线，又有新的眼线，所以他们懒得动手了。
翌日！
一个更炸裂的消息传遍洗礼圣地，星无极主动找上了狼七和花千玥。
消息是秦天从一个被三巨头驱逐到外围的散修口中听到的。

那散修头顶的光环只剩四圈，被天幕抽得面黄肌瘦，说话都带着哆嗦，但叙述得还算清楚。
“星无极带人堵了狼七的老巢，狼七当时头顶数字是26，手下的人被杀了大半，狼七想拼命，被星无极一掌拍飞，撞塌了半座山。”
“然后星无极说，跟我联手，把另一个干掉，以后资源共享。”
“狼七答应了，花千玥那边也差不多，星无极亲自进去谈了一炷香，出来之后花千玥就宣布加入。”
content_en:
They did not stay in the valley long.
The influence of the bloody sky is spreading rapidly. As the bloody sky shrinks, everyone can only flee deeper into the Holy Land.
This also led to more fighting.
Three days later.
A message was delivered.
Xing Wuji intercepted and killed the lone strongman Xiao Yun in public on the Soul-Desolating Cliff in the northern part of the Holy Land.
The number above Xiao Yun's head was 12, which ranked among the top ten in the entire Holy Land. The two of them had not even played a stick of incense on the Soul-Desolating Cliff when Xiao Yun's head was smashed to pieces by Xing Wuji's palm, and the Tianmen Order that exploded turned into a torrent and poured into Xing Wuji's body.
The rules of the Tianmen Token are very simple. The numbers are pure accumulation. The number of Tianmen Tokens you have will be displayed above your head.
So when Xing Wuji walked down from Soul-Desolating Cliff, the number above his head had jumped from 13 to 25.
25.
While everyone was still struggling to break through the twelve rings, Xing Wuji had already reached a height that was beyond the reach of most people.
…
Kill one person and the number will double.
This is the cruelest and most tempting part of the Tianmen Order. You don't need to practice hard or have any insights. You only need to kill someone who has similar numbers to you, and you can surpass others' months of accumulation in an instant.
Xing Wuji obviously knows this well.
After killing Xiao Yun, he did not stop. Instead, he stood on the Broken Soul Cliff and said something to all the people watching.
“Tianmen Baptism Holy Land does not need so many digital existences.
From today on, you must submit to me or die. "
…
In the next three days, the holy land completely turned into a Shura field.
The next day, the western border of the Holy Land.
Wolf Seven caught up with another lone strongman. After the battle, the number above his head jumped from 15 to 26.
Less than half a day after the news spread, Hua Qianyue killed the enemy in the southern border, and the number jumped to 24.
On the third day, Xing Wuji took action again, and the number jumped from 25 to 34.
Within three days, the few remaining lone digital-level experts in the Holy Land were slaughtered by the three giants.
The Tianmen Order in the entire Holy Land concentrated on the three people at an unprecedented speed.
By the morning of the fourth day, Xing Wuji's numbers had reached 34, Lang Qi 26, and Hua Qianyue 24.
When the three of them were added together, the total number exceeded eighty.
The bloody sky has shrunk a lot in the past three days, and the range of movement has become smaller and smaller.
There was no one at the edge of the sky anymore. The casual cultivators who had been wandering on the edge were either beaten into withered bones by the sky, or they tried their best to escape deep into the Holy Land.
Those casual cultivators who did not submit to the Big Three began to feel desperate.
Because the men of the Big Three guard all the passages leading to the core area, and they will be killed if they don't submit.
The entire Holy Land turned into a huge Colosseum.
The Big Three are the three most ferocious beasts in this Colosseum.
Qin Tian and Yin Luoli have not taken action in the past few days.
The reason is that there are spies nearby who are watching them, and all the powerful men are deliberately avoiding them.
After killing the informant, there was a new one, so they were too lazy to take action.
The next day!
An even more explosive news spread throughout the Holy Land of Baptism, and Xing Wuji took the initiative to find Lang Qi and Hua Qianyue.
Qin Tian heard the news from a casual cultivator who was expelled to the periphery by the Big Three.
There were only four rings of halo left on the top of the casual cultivator's head. His face was sallow and his muscles were thin due to the canopy. He was trembling when he spoke, but his narration was quite clear.
"Xing Wuji led people to block Lang Qi's lair. The number above Lang Qi's head was 26 at the time, and most of his men were killed. Lang Qi tried to fight for his life, but Xing Wuji slapped him away with a palm, collapsing half of the mountain."
"Then Xing Wuji said to join forces with me to kill the other one and share resources in the future."
"Lang Qi agreed, and Hua Qianyue's side was similar. Xing Wuji went in personally to talk about it, and after he came out, Hua Qianyue announced that he would join."
